capabilities: search file names, tags, frontmatter properties and commands from a keyboard-first bar
arrange freely positioned, resizable widget cards on one or more dashboards
embed notes, images, canvases, bases, web pages and other plugins' views as cards
detect installed plugins and build a starter dashboard through a setup wizard
export, import and publish dashboards through a shared gallery
extras: The disclaimer states the plugin was created using AI, with human testing before merges and releases. A full separate User Guide is referenced for chapter-by-chapter detail. The dashboard gallery server is included in the repository and runs with one Docker command. All network calls can be silenced with a single Disable external calls setting.
problem: Obsidian opens onto files and folders, with no built-in start page that surfaces tasks, calendar, vault statistics, shortcuts and embedded views in one place.

relations.evidence: The Dataview card: DQL and DataviewJS, rendered live
Tasks cards read one-note-per-task vaults — status, due date and priority from frontmatter, under TaskNotes' own field names
Tasks cards read and write its board notes in its own format
The Git card, acting through the plugin's own task queue
Becomes the engine behind the search bar
The four Operon cards read through Operon's own in-process developer API

requires.name: Dataview, Templater, Git, Kanban, TaskNotes, Omnisearch, Operon and others
Jira bearer PAT for Jira cards

summary: Customizable home-screen dashboard with a fuzzy search bar and a grid of live cards — notes, tasks, calendars, embeds and other plugins' views.
